Welcome to the Four C Retention C R M: Home Alliance's retention C R M, where every customer message, campaign, number, and A.I. agent lives in one place. In the next few minutes, you'll learn where everything is, and how to get there fast.
Start with the Start Here button. It opens this page: the tour, a six step S.O.P., and a finder that takes you straight to any piece of work.
The top bar switches between three projects. Four C Retention keeps and grows our customers. Four C Prospecting wins new ones. And A.I. Office shows the A.I. agents that run both.

Inside Four C Retention, the tab bar holds every workspace. The Calculator is the Q4 plan. Change communications, conversion, or budget, and revenue, bookings, return on ad spend, and cost per booking update instantly.
Retention Point shows preventive maintenance expectations by month, with a brief for each brand. The month over month tab holds the history and next year's projection.
I-MOS is the retention operating system: four modules, each with a clear owner.
Transactional Workflow is the heart of the C R M. Every automated message, from a new lead to the six month check-in, sits on this rail of touchpoints, zero to nine.

Click a touchpoint and a message to see the real email, with its subject line, timing, audience, offer, merge fields, and open issues. Here is the new appliance Care Visit series, on touchpoint eight.
Members covers every Passport communication, by lifecycle stage and channel. The Nurture workflow tab holds the weekly coupons for all five trades.
Non-Member holds the weekly workflow, the nurture campaign, all seven hundred thirty seven Figma email copies, the in-house Figma replica, and the original planner sheet.
The Figma emails tab lets you filter every weekly email by week and by trade.
Brand Logic explains our brands, phone number rotation for texting, email reputation, and lead scoring.
Ten Personas shows what each type of customer receives, week by week. Click any touchpoint on a timeline to open the actual message.
The last tabs cover the reachable database and cohorts, the competitive benchmark, our A.I. board of advisors, and the D7 workflow simulator.
Four C Prospecting is where new customers come from: consented, A.I. led email and text outreach. Everything lives in the left sidebar.
Lead to Loyalty maps the full journey from the first ad to a referral, with a channel map and a twelve month P and L that you can edit.
The Pipeline shows every lead by stage. Drag a card to move it, or click it for the details.
Tech Assignment is our dispatch board. Press Run A.I. dispatch, and the dispatch agent assigns the right technician to each booked job. Amber rows need a dispatcher's decision.
The B2C Database holds purchased homeowner data, with over a hundred fields and intent signals.
Compliance covers consent and texting rules, with the ninety day plan and K.P.I.s right below it.
A.I. Office is a game view of the six A.I. agents that run the C R M, in a tower in Century City. Click a floor to see its blueprint.
The map shows every agent's skill tree: what's live, what's being built, and what comes next.
Stuck? Ask the robot in the top left corner. It answers questions about the project, and points you to the right tab.
Or use the finder on the Start Here page. Type what you need, like coupons, and press Go.
And you're there: Members, nurture workflow. To share any spot, just copy the page address.
That's the Four C Retention C R M. Start Here is always one click away. Welcome aboard.
